messages:
Nora (PM): Short sync: GA readiness for "Falcon Lite". Must cover SLA, docs/runbook, oncall, monitoring, pricing smoke. Goal: sign-off today.

Sam (SRE): Proposed SLA: P99 <= 300ms on rwd-v1 for <=512 tokens; availability >=99.9%. Alerts and runbook needed.

Lina (Eng): Canary passes on staging. I'll add a 15-min prod canary job and a minimal smoke curl to runbook.

Hank (FinOps): I'll publish quota->rate-card mapping for pilot tier and run billing smoke (create org, 500 tokens, expect invoice.created webhook). Need test creds.

Nora (PM): Owners: Nora -> final signoff doc; Sam -> alerts + oncall rota (72h primary); Lina -> canary + docs snippet; Hank -> billing mapping + smoke.

Sam (SRE): Alerts to set: perf.p99 > 300ms (5m) -> Sev2; error.rate > 1% (5m) -> Sev1; availability < 99.9% (30m) -> page. Will block calendar.

Lina (Eng): Smoke snippet for runbook:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-v1","input":"ping"}' | jq .status
```
I'll run it in canary then prod.

Hank (FinOps): Test creds inbound in 30m. I will post expected invoice JSON and webhook sample here.

NotifyBot: Runbook link: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/falcon-lite. Canary checklist attached.

Nora (PM): Please react :thumbsup: to accept. If no objections by 17:00 PT we proceed with launch tomorrow.

Sam (SRE): :thumbsup:

Lina (Eng): :thumbsup:

Hank (FinOps): :thumbsup:
